70:24: 70:24 Those in whose wealth and possessions is a known right,
70:25: 70:25 For him who asks for help, and for him who is deprived.
70:26: 70:26 Those who have conviction in the Day of Judgment. [And therefore, in the Law of Recompense]
70:27: 70:27 Those who are fearful of their Lord's requital.
70:28: 70:28 (They know that) none can feel secure against their Lord's requital.
70:29: 70:29 (Still Musalleen are also) Those men and women who maintain their chastity.
70:30: 70:30 They have intimate relations only with their spouses – that is, those who are rightfully theirs through wedlock. For such relationship they are free of blame. ['Aw' = Or = That is = And. 23:5-7]
70:31: 70:31 But anyone who seeks beyond this, those are the transgressors.
70:32: 70:32 (And Musalleen are) Those who guard their trusts and duties assigned to them, and their pledges, as a shepherd guards his flock.
70:33: 70:33 Those who are truthful as witness and stand by their testimony.
70:34: 70:34 Those who consolidate and protect the Divine System.
70:35: 70:35 (Musalleen are the ones who collectively build paradise on earth and inherit that in the Hereafter.) They will be the honored ones dwelling in the Gardens of bliss.
70:36: 70:36 What then, is the matter with the rejecters that they rush to and fro before you, confused? [Instead of joining hands]
70:37: 70:37 On the right and on the left, in groups.
70:38: 70:38 Does every one of them hope to enter the Garden of bliss with this attitude?
70:39: 70:39 Nay! They know with what We created them. [They know that humans have been created like other members of the animal kingdom. Intellect and free will make humans different. Thus they can strive for the Garden of bliss]
70:40: 70:40 But nay! I call to Witness the Lord of all points in the East and all points in the West, We are Able
70:41: 70:41 To replace them by others better than they are. And We are not to be outrun.
70:42: 70:42 Let them chat and play until they meet their Day which they are promised.
70:43: 70:43 The Day that they shall come forth in haste from their disintegrated states, as if racing toward a goal post.
70:44: 70:44 With their eyes subdued in shame, humiliation overwhelming them. Such is the Day which they were promised again and again.
71:1: 71:1 We sent Noah to his people, 'Warn your people before an awful doom comes to them.'
71:2: 71:2 He said, 'O My people! I am a plain warner to you,
71:3: 71:3 That you serve God and be mindful of Him. Now, do pay heed to me.
71:4: 71:4 He will then protect you from the detriment of trailing behind in humanity and respite you until a term appointed. When the term appointed by God comes, it cannot be delayed, if you but knew this.'
71:5: 71:5 He said, 'My Lord! I have been calling unto my people night and day.
71:6: 71:6 But my call only increases their fleeing.
71:7: 71:7 When I call unto them that You grant them protection against the detriment of their misdeeds, they thrust their fingers in their ears and veil themselves in their garments. And they persist in this behavior glorifying them in pride. [11:5, 71:10]
71:8: 71:8 Then I called unto them aloud.
71:9: 71:9 I addressed them in gatherings and spoke to them individually in private.'
71:10: 71:10 And I have said, 'Seek forgiveness of your Lord. He is ever Forgiving. ['Ghafarah' = Helmet = Protection. Forgiveness in the context indicates halting the behavior that is detrimental to the society, and turning to Divine Guidance in order to protect oneself from the logically harmful consequences of evil deeds]
71:11: 71:11 He will shower upon you heavenly blessings.
71:12: 71:12 And will help you with goods and riches and flourishing families, and will grant you gardens and will bestow upon you flowing streams.' [Baneen = Sons = Children = Tribal unity and strength = Party = Flourishing families]
71:13: 71:13 What is the matter with you that you fail to acknowledge the Majesty of God? [And that His Book can give you eminence. 21:10]
71:14: 71:14 He is the One Who has created you in successive stages.
71:15: 71:15 Do you not realize (not willing to reflect and research) how God has created the seven heavens in great harmony?
71:16: 71:16 And made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a radiant lamp.
71:17: 71:17 And God has caused you to grow as a growth from the earth. [Recall the beginning of life out of water and organic matter, and the stages of evolution. 22:5]
71:18: 71:18 Then He returns you into the earth and He will bring you forth again, a new bringing.
71:19: 71:19 And God has made the earth a wide expanse for you.
71:20: 71:20 That you may travel thereon on spacious valley-ways.
71:21: 71:21 Then Noah said, 'My Lord! They have opposed me throughout, for they follow him whose wealth and children have led him increasingly into ruin.
71:23: 71:23 And keep telling one another, 'Do not abandon your gods! And forsake not Wadd, nor Suw'a, nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.' [They had set up idols: Wadd, the god of masculinity. Suw'a, the goddess of femininity. Yaghuth, the lion god of power. Ya'uq, the horse god for travel and battle. Nasr, the eagle god for flying in to 'steal' the news of the Unseen]
71:24: 71:24 '(O God) They have already misled a great many, therefore, let the wrongdoers increase in straying.'
71:25: 71:25 And so, because of faults upon faults, they were drowned, and then destined to enter the fire. They found out that they had no helpers besides God.
71:26: 71:26 And Noah said, 'My Lord! Leave not any of these rejecters to dwell in this valley.
71:27: 71:27 If you should leave them, they will mislead Your servants and they will only beget division and ingratitude.
71:28: 71:28 My Lord! Grant me the protection of forgiveness and to my parents and whoever enters my house (the ideology of submission to One God) in faith, and to all the believing men and the believing women (of all times). And increase the oppressors in ruin for their violation of human rights.' [Zaalimeen = Oppressors = Violators of human rights = Wrongdoers]
72:1: 72:1  Say (O Prophet) It has been revealed to me that a tribe of nomads listened, and then they said, 'We have heard a marvelous recital. [46:29]
72:2: 72:2 It shows the way to Enlightenment, so we have come to believe in it. And we shall never again ascribe a partner to our Lord.
72:3: 72:3 And Exalted is the Majesty of our Lord. He has taken neither a wife, nor a son.
72:4: 72:4 The foolish among us uttered such outrageous lies about God.
72:5: 72:5 We used to think that people, whether civilized or uncivilized, would never utter a lie about God.
72:6: 72:6 Some people of towns used to seek shelter with some of the nomads and increased them in confusion.
72:7: 72:7 And they thought as you nomads thought that God would never again send forth anyone. [As His Messenger, and so, the claimants to the 'occult sciences' would carry on with their deceptions]
72:8: 72:8 And we tried to feel the skies but found it well attended by mighty guards and flames.' [The shining knowledge in the Qur'an dismisses all conjecture of the astrologers, fortune-tellers, and other claimants of occult sciences]
72:9: 72:9 (The nomads continued), 'And we used to sit on places listening to the 'lofty news'. But now whoever listens will find a flame waiting for him. [The brilliant flame of Divine Revelation is now ready to torch the conjecture of the astrologers. 37:6-9, 67:5]
72:10: 72:10 And we know not whether harm is intended for the inhabitants of the earth, or whether their Lord wills for them Enlightenment.' [It remains to be seen how people will react to this revolutionary Message]
72:11: 72:11 (The nomads continued their conversation), 'Some of us are righteous and others are far from it; we follow varying paths.
72:12: 72:12 We know that wherever we are on earth, we cannot defy God, nor can we flee to escape.
72:13: 72:13 And as soon as we heard the Enlightenment, we believed in it. And whoever chooses to be graced with belief in his Lord, need not fear a diminished return, nor unfairness.
72:14: 72:14 And some of us have submitted (to God) while there are others who make compromises (between the right and wrong). Those who submit (to God), they have found the path to right guidance.
72:15: 72:15 And those who make compromises (between the right and wrong,) they are but fuel for the Hellfire.'
72:16: 72:16 (Such was their conversation.) If they take an unwavering stand on the Highest Discipline, We will shower them with abundant bounties. [Tareeqah = Layer upon layer arranged in great harmony = Discipline = The Way = Course. At-Tareeqah = The Highest Discipline = Divine Revelation. Maa = Water, heavenly blessings = Bounties]
72:17: 72:17 That We may test them (let them try their own mettle) thereby. And whoever turns away from his Lord's Reminder, He will cause him to undergo an everincreasing retribution. [20:124]
72:18: 72:18 And the Masjids, one and all, belong to God alone. So, do not call upon anyone along with God. [Masjids = Mosques = Places to hold congregations = Collective acts of submission = Community Centers = Ways of adoration = Obedience of Divine Commands = Centers of administering the Divine System. 9:17]
72:19: 72:19 Yet whenever a servant of God stands up with invitation to Him, they crowd on him in hostility. [22:72]
72:20: 72:20 Say, 'I call upon my Lord alone and associate no one with Him' [I do not heed religious 'authorities']
72:21: 72:21 Say, 'I do not own the power to harm you or enforce right guidance upon you.'
72:22: 72:22 Say, 'No one can shelter me from (the consequences of violating the laws of) God, nor can I find a hide-out from Him,
72:23: 72:23 If I fail to convey to people what I receive from God and make His Messages known.' Whoever disobeys God and His Messenger; for him is Hellfire, to abide therein forever.
72:24: 72:24 Until they see what they are promised. And so, soon will they find out who is really helpless and counts for less!
72:25: 72:25 Say, 'I do not know whether the promise made to you is near or if my Lord will delay it.'
72:26: 72:26 Knower of the Unseen (and the future), and He makes known to none His secret,
72:27: 72:27 Except as He wills to a Messenger whom He has elected, and to him He reveals from the past and the future, and ensures that the Revelation is guarded. [God Himself guards the Perfected Final Revelation, hence no more Apostles will come. Al- Qur'an is now the Messenger for all times. 15:9]
72:28: 72:28 Thus He knows that the Messengers have delivered their Lord's Messages. For, He is the One Who encompasses all the Revelation they have, and takes account of all things.
73:1: 73:1 O You (Prophet) the great selector of companions, the best caravan leader!
73:2: 73:2 Stay vigilant even by night, and never fall short on it - [As Head of the State the Prophet is responsible for arranging peace and security for all citizens (17:79, 76:26). 'Illa' here, as in many other verses, represents 'never', and not 'except' (11:107-108, 55:33, 87:6-7). 'Al-Manar' vol 1 Pg 414]
73:3: 73:3 Half of it, or a little less.
73:4: 73:4 Or, you shall increase it whenever warranted. And convey the Qur'an in a calm distinctive manner, stage by stage.
73:5: 73:5 We are charging you with a substantial declaration (a lofty mission).
73:6: 73:6 The vigil of the night impresses the minds most strongly, and the speech is most upright. [Mutual consultation with companions is better done in the silence of night]
73:7: 73:7 By day you are engaged in continued strife.
73:8: 73:8 Keep eminent the Name of your Lord and detach yourself from needless pursuits for His sake.
73:9: 73:9 Lord of the East and the West! There is no god but He. So, hold on to Him as Dispenser of affairs.
73:10: 73:10 Endure with patience whatever people may say, and leave them graciously. [5:13, 15:85]
73:11: 73:11 And leave to Me the deniers who enjoy the blessings of life. And bear with them for a little while.
73:12: 73:12 With Us are shackles and a Blazing Fire.
73:13: 73:13 And a choking food and an awful doom.
73:14: 73:14 The Day is coming when the masses and the wealthy tyrants will shake and the leaders will become heaps of sand.
73:15: 73:15 We have sent to you a Messenger to be a witness concerning you, just as We had sent to Pharaoh a Messenger.
73:16: 73:16 But Pharaoh rebelled against the Messenger, whereupon We seized him with a calamitous seizing.
73:17: 73:17 So, how, if you keep rejecting, will you guard yourselves on a Day which will turn children gray. [A horrifying Day]
73:18: 73:18 The very sky will then be rent asunder. His promise always comes to pass. ['Sky getting asunder' may also mean fall of the arrogant leaders]
73:19: 73:19 This Qur'an is a Reminder, a giver of eminence. So, whoever wills, let him set out on a way to his Lord.
73:20: 73:20 (O Messenger) your Lord is fully Aware that you stay up working two thirds of the night, one half of it, or one third of it, together with some of your companions. But God has designed the night and the day, and He knows that you and your companions will not even keep count of your vigil. So He turns to you in kindness. Teach them as much of the Qur'an that you can do with ease. He knows that in time some of you may be ill, and others have to travel seeking God's bounty - And others who will have to fight in the cause of God. Therefore, recite and convey as much of the Qur'an as may be easy for all. You have to establish the Divine System and set up the Just Economic Order. Remember (all of you) to lend a goodly loan to God. Whatever good you send forth for your own 'self' you will find with God, better and more excellent in reward. And seek the protection of forgiveness of God for any imperfections. Certainly, God is Forgiving, Merciful.
74:1: 74:1 O You founder of the most Benevolent Order!
74:2: 74:2 Rise up to the occasion and post danger signs on the highway of Life.
74:3: 74:3 Establish the greatness of your Lord on earth!
74:4: 74:4 Keep a spotless character! [Literally but erroneously, purify your garments]
74:5: 74:5 Leave alone those who are lazy. ['Rujz' = A neurological disease in the cattle and camels that prevents them from rising from a sitting position to standing in one smooth and sharp movement]
74:6: 74:6 Seek not rivalry in material gains. [30:39, 76:9]
74:7: 74:7 And be steadfast for the Mission of your Lord.
74:8: 74:8 For when the Trumpet is sounded,
74:9: 74:9 That will be the Day – A Day of hardship,
74:10: 74:10 Not of ease, for all who deny the truth.
74:11: 74:11 Leave it to Me alone to decide about him whom I alone have created. [This is another verse forbidding worldly punishment for deniers of the truth or 'apostates']
74:12: 74:12 And then granted him abundant wealth and resources. [73:11]
74:13: 74:13 And children and party abiding in his presence.
74:14: 74:14 And made life comfortable for him like a cradle.
74:15: 74:15 But he keeps increasing in greed, desiring more and more.
74:16: 74:16 Nay, he has been a stubborn opponent of Our Revelations.
74:17: 74:17 I will make him walk an exhausting uphill climb.
74:19: 74:19 Woe to him! How he determined.
74:20: 74:20 Woe to him again! How he determined.
74:23: 74:23 And then he turned away in pride.
74:24: 74:24 And said, 'All this is a remnant of ancient magic.
74:25: 74:25 This is nothing but the speech of a human.'
74:26: 74:26 I shall soon cast him into Saqar.
74:27: 74:27 Ah, what will convey to you what Saqar is!
74:28: 74:28 A fire that lets not live and lets not die. [Fire of Regret, Remorse, Anguish]
74:29: 74:29 Charring the very being of a mortal,
74:30: 74:30 Over it are nineteen. [Nineteen = Many vices and character traits that push people to the Fire of Regret]
74:31: 74:31 We have appointed none but universal laws to be the keepers of the Fire. And We have made this number (nineteen) a trial for unbelievers. But believers who have been given this Book will harbor no doubt about any allegories and only in ease in Faith. The hypocrites and the deniers may say, 'What does God mean by this parable?' Thus, God lets go astray him who wills to go astray, and guides him who wills to be guided. And no one knows the forces of your Lord but He. This Qur'an is nothing but a Reminder to mankind. [See 2:26, 3:7. See 41:53 Soon, shall We show them Our signs in the utmost horizons and within themselves until it becomes obvious to them that this Qur'an is certainly the Truth. Is it not enough that your Lord is Witness to all things? 3:7, 9:31-33, 13:31, 14:48, 18:48, 41:53, 48:28, 51:20-21, 61:9]
74:33: 74:33 And the Night when it departs.
74:34: 74:34 And the Dawn as it shines forth.
74:35: 74:35 This (the fore-going) is one of the greatest allegories (that the revolution is coming in all its splendor).
74:36: 74:36 This is a forewarning for every human being.
74:37: 74:37 To every one of you, whether he chooses to advance or to lag behind.
74:38: 74:38 Every person is held in pledge for all that he has done. [52:21]
74:39: 74:39 But those who will stand on the right hand side. [The righteous ones. Yameen = A metaphor for righteousness and success. They have actualized their own 'self' by doing good to others]
74:41: 74:41 Of those who used to steal the fruit of others' toil.
74:42: 74:42 'What has led you into Saqar?' [A fire that lets not live and lets not die. Fire of Regret 74:28]
74:43: 74:43 They will reply, 'We were not of the Musalleen.' [Who are Musalleen? 70:22-35. The Musalleen (from Salaat - are not the so called ritualistic praying ones, but) Those who always follow the Divine System. Those in whose wealth and possessions is a known right. For him who asks for help, and for him who is deprived. Those who have conviction in the Day of Judgment. Those who are fearful of their Lord's requital. (They know that) none can feel secure against their Lord's requital. (Still Musalleen are also) Those men and women who maintain their chastity. They have intimate relations only with their spouses – that is, those who are rightfully theirs through wedlock. For such relationship they are free of blame. But anyone who seeks beyond this, those are the transgressors. (And Musalleen are) Those who guard their trusts and duties assigned to them, and their pledges, as a shepherd guards his flock. Those who are truthful as witness and stand by their testimony. Those who consolidate and protect the Divine System. (Musalleen are the ones who collectively build paradise on earth and inherit that in the Hereafter.) They will be the honored ones dwelling in the Gardens of bliss. 70:22-35]
74:44: 74:44 'Neither did we feed the hungry, nor did we take part in helping those who had lost their jobs, those whose businesses had stalled, and those whose hard-earned income was insufficient to meet their basic needs.'
74:45: 74:45 'And we were among those who used to say what they did not do.'
74:46: 74:46 'And we used to deny the Day of Judgment and that the Divine System will eventually prevail,'
74:47: 74:47 'Till the inevitable truth came to us.'
74:48: 74:48 Then no mediation of any mediator will help.
74:49: 74:49 What, then, is the matter with them that they are turning away from a clear Advisory?
74:50: 74:50 As if they were frightened zebras.
74:52: 74:52 Nay, each one of them wants to be given the scrolls of Revelation personally, unfolded.
74:53: 74:53 They do not fear the Hereafter.
74:55: 74:55 So whoever wills may take it to heart.
74:56: 74:56 But they will not take it to heart except according to God's Laws (of guidance). He is the Lord of righteousness, and the Lord of forgiveness. [4:88, 76:30, 81:29]
75:1: 75:1 Nay! I call to witness the Day of Resurrection. [We can see this in our daily lives in the Law of Cause and Effect, 'As you sow so shall you reap', the Law of Recompense. What goes around comes around. And, in how the dead earth comes to new life with rains. Also, in our sleep-wake cycle where our consciousness is withdrawn during sleep and restored as we wake up. 6:60]
75:2: 75:2 Nay, I call to witness the person who shows remorse after wrongdoing. [Notice the laws taking the first step instantly. 12:53]
75:3: 75:3 Does the human being think that We will not assemble his bones? [36:78, 37:16. Life goes on with its essence, the 'self', surviving disintegration]
75:4: 75:4 We have the power to restore his very finger tips. [Science came to know about the uniqueness of the fingerprints only in the 19th century. Even the twins have their own uniquely different fingerprints]
75:5: 75:5 But man is after subverting his own future.
75:6: 75:6 (Yet) he asks, 'When will this Day of Resurrection be?'
75:7: 75:7 But when the sight is dazzled,
75:8: 75:8 And the moon is darkened. [The banner of the Age of Ignorance bearing the moon logo goes down]
75:9: 75:9 And the sun and the moon are brought together. [Persia and Arabia come under one Rule. Sun being the logo on the Persian banner]
75:10: 75:10 On that Day man will wonder, 'Where to flee!' [In this life and in the life to come. verses 7-10 could easily allude to the merging of the super power of the times, Persia with the newly enlightened Arabia in 642 CE, 10 years after the exalted Prophet's death]
75:11: 75:11 But, nay! No height to mount above the turmoil!
75:12: 75:12 Unto your Lord that Day is the resting place.
75:13: 75:13 On the Day when man is apprised of all his acts of commission and omission. [All he has done and left undone. All deeds that advanced him and kept him behind]
75:14: 75:14 Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself.
75:15: 75:15 Even though he were to put forward all his excuses.
75:16: 75:16 (Whenever you recite the Qur'an) do not recite in haste stirring your tongue. [20:114]
75:17: 75:17 It is up to Us to gather and preserve it and the reading of it. [He will bless whatever effort we put into its learning]
75:18: 75:18 Thus, when We read it, follow the reading. [Although these verses are addressed to the exalted Prophet, every believer can sense as if the Qur'an is talking to him/her]
75:19: 75:19 Then, it is for Us to explain it. [The Qur'an is its own best commentary. It explains itself]
75:20: 75:20 Nay, but you love instant results,
75:21: 75:21 And give little thought to the long term. [Aakhirah = Hereafter = Life to come = Future = Long term = What follows = Subsequent = Enduring. Tomorrow is today's Aakhirah]
75:22: 75:22 Some faces that Day will beam with happiness.
75:24: 75:24 And some faces on that Day will be despondent.
75:26: 75:26 Nay, when the last breaths come up to the throat.
75:27: 75:27 And those around cry, 'Is there any charmer?'
75:28: 75:28 But he knows that this is the parting.
75:29: 75:29 And it is pang upon pang.
75:30: 75:30 That day the drive is to your Lord.
75:31: 75:31 For he neither stood by the truth, nor did he follow it. [Sall = To follow, like the runner-up horse closely follows the winner, Saabiq = To closely follow the commands of God]
75:32: 75:32 Rather, he used to deny and turn away.
75:33: 75:33 And then used to go to his family gleefully.
75:34: 75:34 This is the most befitting for you - now this is the most befitting.
75:35: 75:35 Again! This is the most befitting for you - now this is the most befitting. [The impending requital befits the behavior]
75:36: 75:36 Does man think he will be left alone like a broken musical string?
75:37: 75:37 Was he not gametes that moved to join?
75:38: 75:38 Then he became a zygote. And He shaped and fashioned him in due proportion.
75:39: 75:39 And He has made of humans pairs, male and female.
75:40: 75:40 Is He not, then, Able to bring the dead to life?
76:1: 76:1 Has there not passed over man an era when he was not even worth mentioning?
76:2: 76:2 We have created the human being from marked out cells, male and female gametes, that joined. Then We passed him through subtle changes. And then We made him a being endowed with hearing and sight.
76:3: 76:3 We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or ungrateful.
76:4: 76:4 For those who oppose the truth We have readied chains and shackles and a blazing flame. [Chains and shackles of conjecture, blind following and superstition, and the fire of confusion and regret are the logical consequences of relegating the truth. 7:157]
76:5: 76:5 The truly virtuous will drink from a cup sweetened with nectar of flowers. [Kaafoor = Camphor = Cool temperament = Nectar from the calyx of grape as it flowers = Sweet and fragrant drink of Divine bliss]
76:6: 76:6 A spring whereof the servants of God drink – it is they who make it flow in abundance. [The true servants of God achieve His blessings of guidance and all that is good, and share them with fellow human beings]
76:7: 76:7 They fulfill their vows and pledges and fear (and therefore, guard against) the times when chaos and corruption might sweep the society.
76:8: 76:8 And they lovingly provide the basic needs of life to those whose income has stalled and those left alone in the society and those who are stranded on earth for any reason - [They help establish the System where the first ones to receive the provisions of God are the ones who are needy, who have lost their jobs, whose finances have stalled, the widows, the orphans, the ones who feel left alone in the society, the captives or those who are stranded on earth for any reason, ['Ta'aam' = Food = Basic needs. 'Miskeen' = Whose finances have stalled. 'Yateem' = Orphan = Widow = Left alone in the society. 'Aseer' = Captive = Imprisoned = Stranded]
76:9: 76:9 Saying, 'We provide for you for the sake of God alone. We want no return from you, not even a word of thanks.
76:10: 76:10 We fear the times when the society will become a picture of frowning and distress for defying our Lord's admonition.'
76:11: 76:11 So, God wards off from them the chaos of those times, and showers on them inner splendor and delight. [Yaum = Day = Stage = Times = Era = Eventuality = The Resurrection Day]
76:12: 76:12 And for their steadfastness He rewards them with a Garden of bliss and garments of silk (granting honor).
76:13: 76:13 Relaxing therein on beautiful furnishings, they neither find a hot sun nor chill.
76:14: 76:14 Pleasant shades close upon them and clusters of fruits reach them low.
76:15: 76:15 And they are served with goblets of silver and cups of crystal.
76:16: 76:16 Silver trays shining as crystal - all this design they have determined (with their good deeds).
76:17: 76:17 And delicious invigorating drinks they shall be given. [43:71, 76:5, 83:27. Camphor: allegory for cool relaxation. Ginger: allegory for warmth and action]
76:18: 76:18 From therein a spring named Salsabeel. The water thereof seeks its own way to them. [88:12. Salsabeel = The stream that finds its way to them]
76:19: 76:19 And their children, immortal, playing around, lovely as pearls when you see them.
76:20: 76:20 And whenever you look around there you see bliss and a Magnificent Kingdom.
76:21: 76:21 Upon them will be garments of green silk with gold embroidery, and they will be honored with bracelets of silver. And their Lord will give them pure refreshing drinks.
76:22: 76:22 Behold! All this is your reward since your effort has found a befitting acceptance.
76:23: 76:23 Most certainly, We have revealed to you the Qur'an from Our Presence. [I tend to agree with Muhammad Asad that this verse addresses any sincere student of the Qur'an]
76:24: 76:24 Therefore, hold on to your Lord's command unwaveringly. And do not heed any sinner or unbeliever. [Aathim = 'Sinner' from Ithm = One who depletes individual or communal energy]
76:25: 76:25 Raise the Name of your Lord morning and evening. [Zikr = Remembrance = Commemoration = Raise = Celebrate = Magnify = Give eminence = Taking to heart = Keeping in mind]
76:26: 76:26 Adore Him even at night and strive to establish His glory on earth through long nights (as you do morning and evening).
76:27: 76:27 But there are those who love the instant gains and neglect the remembrance of a grievous day.
76:28: 76:28 (Who gave them the mind and body to behave the way they choose?) We created them, and strengthened their frame. But whenever We will, We can substitute others in their place. [People that will use their human potentials better. 70:41]

86:3: 86:3 The Brightest Star! The noble night-visitant with the Radiant Lamp of the Qur'an in his hand knocking at the doors of minds and hearts, giving light.
86:4: 86:4 There is no person without a watch being kept over him. [The Law of Requital is ever-vigilant]
86:5: 86:5 Let the human being, then, consider out of what he has been created. [And realize the common origin of all mankind. Has there not passed over man an era when he was not even worth mentioning? 76:1]
86:6: 86:6 He has been created from turbulent water. [21:30, 24:45]
86:7: 86:7 That issued from between tough rocks and mingled dust. [Sulb = Hard = Tough = Strong, Rocky, as given in Taajil 'Uroos and Muheet. Turaab = Dust, with Turaaib as its plural in Taajil Urus. Mountains, rocky as pegs, along with the glacier systems and snow tops and sources of rivers, have been described as water reservoirs in many verses: 13:3, 15:19, 31:10, 39:5, 77:27, 79:28- 30, 88:20. For the origin of life on the planet and creation of the human being, including the beginning of life through water, dust, hydrated inorganic matter etc, here are given some important references for the research-minded reader: 4:1, 6:2, 6:38, 6:99, 7:11, 11:6, 11:61, 15:26, 21:30, 23:12-14, 24:45, 25:54, 30:20, 31:28, 32:7-9, 35:11, 36:77, 39:6, 40:64-67, 51:49, 53:45, 55:14, 71:14, 76:2-3, 86:5-7, 96:1-2. My rendition of three terms used in 86:6- 7 respectfully differs from other translations. We know how valuable the principle of Tasreef-il- Ayaat is. Now, here are those three terms along with their erroneous translations: - 'Ma-in-Dafiq': A drop emitted, seminal fluid or gushing fluid. - 'Sulb': Man's ribs, man's loins. - 'Turaib': Pelvic arch of woman, back-bone and the ribs, spine and the viscera of man and/or woman, sacrum of man or woman. But keeping in view the lexicon and the Tasreef given above, my humble rendition of these verses is probably more sound and reflects the original magnificence to an extent]

87:2: 87:2 Who creates and proportions. [So that all things might become what they are meant to be]
87:3: 87:3 The One Who appoints due measure and then shows the way (to all things as to their functions.)
87:4: 87:4 The One Who brings forth the lush pasture.
87:5: 87:5 And then turns it into rust-brown residue. [18:45]

He is Aware of man's manifest actions and his hidden potentials which can best be developed under Divine Guidance. Therefore, the Prophet will never forget what God teaches him. 73:2. Illa = Except = Save = But. It means 'Never' when applied to Divine will. So Illa here, as in many other verses, represents 'never', and not 'except'. 11:107-108, 39:68, 55:33, 87:6-7. Tafseer Al-Manar Vol 1 Pg 414]
87:8: 87:8 And thus We shall ease your way to the ultimate ease (that you will establish the Divine Order in the society).
87:9: 87:9 Therefore, keep reminding as long as it is beneficial.
87:10: 87:10 He will heed who fears (the consequences of his misdeeds).
87:11: 87:11 And only the most unfortunate will avoid it.
87:12: 87:12 He who will be cast into the great fire.
87:13: 87:13 Wherein he neither dies nor lives. [Mere survival. Without Permanent Values people live an unlived life. And in both lives their own 'self' fails to make progress. 87:14: 87:14 Successful is he who primes his own 'self' for development (by living a life upright).
87:15: 87:15 And remembers the Name of his Lord and then follows His commands. ['Ism' = Name = Attributes. 'Salu' = Follow closely. In the context here: trying to adopt the 'Hue' of God, the Divine attributes, in the human capacity 2:138, 83:28]
87:16: 87:16 But nay, you prefer the life of this world (given to instant gains instead of benefiting others that ensures success in both lives). [2:201, 3:147, 4:134, 7:156, 10:64,17:72, 28:77, 42:22]

89:1: 89:1 Witness is the Daybreak. [As it shines through the deep darkness of the night. So does the Qur'an bring light through the Darkness of Ignorance]
89:2: 89:2 And ten Nights. [Believers have noticed the benevolent transformation the Pilgrimage has undergone. From the first to the tenth of the month of Zilhijjah, they used to indulge in all kind of obscenity. They had departed from the way of Abraham, with Hajj consisting of whistling, clapping, circumambulating the Ka'bah in complete nudity. The sublime purpose of the Pilgrimage had been reduced to senseless rituals and abomination 2:125-127, 2:197]
89:3: 89:3 And the Even and the Odd. [Recall your gambling in those ten nights with the even and odd numbers of arrows and the related numeric superstitions in the society]
89:4: 89:4 And Witness to the truth is the departing of the Night of Ignorance.
89:5: 89:5 Is not all this a solemn evidence for every thinking person?
89:6: 89:6 Have you noted how your Lord dealt with 'Aad? [They had refused to listen to their Prophets on equitable treatment with the poor and violated human rights. 7:65- 72]
89:7: 89:7 Those whose capital was Iram, the city of towers and lofty mansions. [Iram were the generation of Iram son of Sam son of Noah. The capital of the tribe of 'Aad bears the same name, Iram, and now lies buried in Al-Ahqaf, the Sand-dunes of Southern Arabia. 46:21]
89:8: 89:8 The like of which (the towers and castles) were never built in other cities. [26:128- 134]
89:9: 89:9 And with Thamud, who carved out rocks for dwellings in the valley. [Wadi-al- Qura. 7:74, 15:82]
89:10: 89:10 And with Pharaoh, lord of the pyramids. [20:43, 38:12, 43:78-79. Zil-awtad = Lord of stakes = A mighty emperor = Owner of many tents with pegs well-dug into the ground = Owner of the Pyramids. God's Laws are also the Laws of Nature and the rise and fall of nations is fully subject to them]
89:11: 89:11 They all played god in towns and cities. [Tagha = Crossing limits = Transgressing the laws = Trespassing = Being rebellious = Ignoring Permanent Values = Behaving arrogantly = Being Taaghoot or false god = Playing god. 2:256, 4:60, 4:76, 16:36]
89:12: 89:12 And increased corruption and crime therein.
89:13: 89:13 And so, your Lord chastised them with a whipping punishment.
89:14: 89:14 Indeed, your Lord is ever on the watch!
89:15: 89:15 As for man, whenever his Lord lets his life take a turn by giving him honor and bliss, he says, 'My Lord has honored me.' [Honor and disgrace are subject to Divine Laws]
89:16: 89:16 But when He lets his life take a turn by restricting his provision, he says, 'My Lord has disgraced me.'
89:17: 89:17 Nay, nay, you do not honor the orphan. [You forget to realize your acts of commission and omission. Yateem = Orphan = Widow = Left alone in the society = Helpless. A benevolent society makes room for the 'Yateem']
89:18: 89:18 And you fail to encourage one another to feed the needy (and establish a benevolent society). [The term used for 'feeding' is highly inclusive. Here it indicates failing to establish the ideal society that takes care of all individuals. Miskeen = Poor = Needy = Whose life is stranded for any reason = Whose business has stalled = Who has lost his job = Whose life has been hampered by circumstances. Ta'aam = Feeding = Food = Provision = Basic needs of life. A benevolent society takes care of the basic needs of life. None would sleep hungry therein]
89:19: 89:19 And you devour the inheritances with greed.
89:20: 89:20 And you love wealth with boundless love.
89:21: 89:21 Nay, when the earth is pounded into rubble.
89:22: 89:22 And your Lord comes, and His angels, rank upon rank. [A great Revolution will come and the Divine System will be established. The universal forces will line up to that end]
89:23: 89:23 And Hell is brought close that Day. On that Day man will heed the Advisory, but of what avail will then be the remembrance?
89:24: 89:24 He will say, 'Ah, I wish I had sent forth some good for my life!'
89:25: 89:25 None chastises as He will chastise on that Day.
89:26: 89:26 And none binds as He binds. [The logical result of disregarding the Creator's guidance is getting bound by shackles of mental slavery. 7:157]
89:27: 89:27 But Oh! You human beings that have attained inner peace! [By living a life upright 13:28, 91:9]
89:28: 89:28 Return to your Lord, pleased and approved.
89:29: 89:29 Enter, then, together with My servants.

90:20: 90:20 With fire of regret all around them. [The Hellfire is such that its flames originate in, and engulf the hearts. The fire of regret, anguish and despair. 104:6-8]

96:1: 96:1 Read! With the Name of your Lord Who created.

96:18: 96:18 We shall summon the apprehending forces.
96:19: 96:19 Nay, never be intimidated by a man like this! But humble yourself in adoration to Divine Commands, and let every step of yours bring you closer (to your Lord).

They do works of collective good, helping those who lag behind, and improving the individual and collective potentials of humanity. c. They uphold Al-Haqq (the truth) instead of hearsay and conjecture. They refrain from violating Haqq (human rights) which is always the first casualty of an order based upon falsehood. d. They know that the benefit of the individual and the benefit of the society are strongly interwoven. Therefore, they are patient in times of ease and prosperity by not falling for rivalry in material possessions. And they are steadfast in times of adversity, natural disasters and armed confrontation]
